about.bio: Principal Software Engineer & System Architect with 8+ years delivering production systems at scale. At BJIT, I architected platforms handling 500K+ daily transactions at 99.9% uptime, mentored 8+ engineers across full product lifecycles, and drove CI/CD transformations that cut deployment failures from 15% → 2%. I build across the full stack — NestJS/Node.js microservices to React/Next.js frontends — and integrate AI tools (OpenAI GPT, Claude, Cursor AI) to amplify team velocity. Open to Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Tech Lead roles in product-driven engineering organizations.

philosophy.title: Cloud-Native Architecture
philosophy.desc: I architect cloud-native platforms on AWS and Azure using microservices, API Gateway, and Saga patterns — handling 500K+ daily transactions at 99.9% uptime with independent scaling and resilient deployments.

philosophy.title: Performance Engineering
philosophy.desc: I eliminate bottlenecks through query optimization (55% faster), caching strategies, cursor-based pagination, and efficient data pipelines — reducing page load times from 3s to 1.2s and bundle sizes by 35%.

philosophy.title: DevOps & Reliability
philosophy.desc: CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Kubernetes cut deployment effort by 70% and reduced deployment failures from 15% to 2%. I apply IAM governance, secrets management, and encryption at every layer.

philosophy.title: Technical Leadership
philosophy.desc: I've mentored 8+ engineers across full product lifecycles — 3 promoted to mid-level, 2 leading independent projects. I set architecture standards, run design reviews, and align engineering execution with business goals.

testimonials.name: MD Badrul Hasan Tushar
testimonials.jobTitle: Software Architect | Engineering Manager | AWS, Docker, Microservices, Kubernetes
testimonials.text: I worked with him for over three years, and he consistently operates far beyond the level of a typical Senior Engineer. Mahbub doesn't just write great code. He takes complete ownership of his projects from start to finish. He understands the big picture and knows exactly how to deliver software that creates the most value for the business. Give him a complex challenge, and he will figure it out. He handles technical debt and tight deadlines with incredible agility. No matter how high the pressure gets, Mahbub stays completely calm and focused. He also has a deep growth mindset. He is always learning, and his drive naturally makes everyone around him better. Mahbub is the engineer you can trust with your hardest problems. Any team would be incredibly lucky to have him, and he has my absolute highest recommendation.

testimonials.name: Md. Fazla Rabbi Opu
testimonials.jobTitle: Agile Leader | Solution Architect | Technical Project Manager
testimonials.text: I had the opportunity to work with Mahabub as a Project Manager for the past three years, and throughout this time I found him to be extremely dedicated and reliable. One of his standout qualities is his strong ownership mindset—every task assigned to him was taken with full responsibility and delivered with the right outcomes. Mahabub is also a quick learner and highly adaptable. Whenever project needs required a change in technology or approach, he not only switched tech stacks smoothly but also developed strong expertise in them in a short time. I wish him all the best and strongly recommend him for his adaptability, dedication, and commitment to excellence.

projects.title: E-parts – Catalog Management Platform
projects.stack: React · TypeScript · MUI · TanStack Query · SignalR · .NET 10 · Azure Functions · Fabric SQL · Dataverse · Azure Blob · Azure DevOps
bullets: Led full-stack delivery of a scalable mill data platform covering sync, BOM management, and real-time collaborative editing.
Built React/TypeScript UI with TanStack Query and lazy BOM loading — reduced API calls by ~60–70% and improved large-table render speed by ~80–90%.
Implemented Azure SignalR locks for concurrent editing to prevent data conflicts across multiple users.
Built Azure Functions (.NET 10) with Durable Functions for Fabric → Dataverse sync — ~40–60% faster large-mill sync and ~50–90% less repeat sync data via delta sync.
Optimized Dataverse bulk writes with streaming pipelines; delivered BOM, Translations, Mill Search, Excel import, Activity Log, and Action Server integrations.

projects.title: Shin Sagantosu Fan Token – Store Discovery Platform

Implemented Google Maps integration with custom marker clustering, dynamic bounds fitting, and resolved race condition bugs via ref-based state tracking.

Owned CI/CD deployment workflows on AWS Amplify with DynamoDB and RDS for high-availability data persistence.
